bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; s=0; docker inspect --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 | grep -qx 'GAYBBS_ROOM_EVENT_WORKER_ENABLED=enabled' || s=$((s+1)); docker inspect --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 | grep -qx 'GAYBBS_ROOM_STATUS_EDIT_ENABLED=enabled' || s=$((s+2)); docker inspect --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 | grep -qx 'GAYBBS_NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_ENABLED=enabled' || s=$((s+4)); q="SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature IN ('room','announcement') AND enabled=TRUE"; count=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tAqc "$q" | tr -d '[:space:]'); test "$count" = 2 || s=$((s+8)); exit "$((80+s))"
